name: Natsume Akina
source: As a child, Natsume often played with Rin and Tomoya, and she was like an older sister to them, but then she suddenly parted with them and showed up just now, in school. Akina is a girl from the rich noble family, and that leaves its mark on her personal life. The protagonist will have to work hard in order to stay with this girl.
